comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
A Memorial Album consisting of seven items which must be created by modifying base items with transmutation alchemy and "Sophia" points. Related to Legacy TH6. Praise Our Great Goddess though I do not believe you need all the discoveries to unlock each recipe (if I'm wrong, I'll note this later).

MA Items:

Ancient Priest's Blessed Clothes
Ancient Priest's Blessed Hat
Ancient Priest's Blessed Shoes
Decorative Small Boat Blueprint (received automatically on discovering the center Legacy)
Artemis of Ephesus
Diamond
Sailors' Wooden Goddess Figurine

The MA can be reported to Rossana(Istanbul). The reward is: Ancient Noble's Clothes
Details on its page.

As with other Legacy MAs, special character nicknames are awarded for completing the MA and obtaining its reward. These will be added later when the translated versions are known.

Source: wittyship.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-1262.html

comments.body: The english name of this MA is "Recollection of the Earth Goddesses".
